saints.name: St. Hilarion
saints.title: Abbot
saints.shortBlurb: The father of monastic life in Palestine, a disciple of St. Anthony whose life St. Jerome recorded…
biography: Born of pagan parents near Gaza about 291, Hilarion was converted while studying at Alexandria and sought out the great hermit St. Anthony in the Egyptian desert. Returning home, he gave away his inheritance and took up a life of extreme austerity in the wilderness near the sea, becoming the first to plant the anchoritic life in Palestine.

Disciples gathered around him and monasteries multiplied, but fleeing the crowds that his reputed miracles attracted, he wandered through Egypt, Sicily, Dalmatia, and at last Cyprus, where he died about 371. His life was written soon afterward by St. Jerome, who prized him as a model of the solitary vocation.
saints.knownFor: Bringing the monastic life to Palestine.
